label: PF Backlog 551
title: groom->approve flow: summary + ask + --approve chaining (one item and bulk)
body:
## Why
After grooming, items sit in analysis=IN_PROGRESS (a proposal) and require a separate approve call, with no
summary or prompt - confusing. Make groom surface what happened and connect grooming to approval.

## What
- groom / groom-all show a summary (groomed / approved / flagged / pending_approval) and ask to approve when
  interactive; non-interactive callers get needs_approval/pending_approval to prompt with.
- --approve chains decide(_all)(APPROVE): clean proposals become COMPLETE/eligible in one call; flagged items
  (consolidation / low-confidence / unimplementable) are returned, not auto-approved.
- Docs: the /pf command now instructs show-summary-then-ask before approving.

## Where
- core/grooming.py (groom approve=, groom_all approve= + summary); scripts/pf.py (--approve, _ask, summary).
- /pf command docs (.opencode/command + command_global).

## Verify
- single groom --approve -> analysis COMPLETE; flagged item stays IN_PROGRESS; grooming_check OK; 17 tests.
